query: Build a shared shopping list in a Bun app with @blueshed/delta: lists, each with items (text, done). Everyone with a list open sees the others' changes at once. Keep the data in a JSON file to start with. Then show the change that moves the same app to SQLite, keeping the browser code exactly as it is and carrying the existing lists across.
expected_behavior: One defineSchema (items with parent: "lists") and one defineDoc("list:", { root: "lists", include: ["items"], ... }), used unchanged by both steps
The JSON step registers with registerDocs(ws, file, schema, docs) from @blueshed/delta/json, not registerDoc from @blueshed/delta/server and not a hand-written file store

The SQLite step changes only the server's wiring: createTables(db, schema), then registerDocs(ws, db, schema, docs) from @blueshed/delta/sqlite; the schema, the document and the client are the same files
Carries the data with exportTables from @blueshed/delta/json and importTables from @blueshed/delta/sqlite, not by copying rows by hand
The client uses connectWs and openDoc from @blueshed/delta/client and installs @blueshed/railroad beside delta
New items are sent as add /items/- with the server naming the id; done is changed with replace /items/<id>/done

No optimistic update and no fetch or reload: the page changes only through onOps or doc.data, and one keyed render path (applyOpsToCollection or railroad's list()) serves the first paint and every change
The server is Bun.serve with routes { [ws.path]: ws.upgrade }, websocket: ws.websocket, then ws.setServer(server)

query: Our Bun app keeps a shared board in delta on SQLite (registerDocs with a board: document). Add Undo and Redo buttons to each browser. Two people edit the same board at once: my Undo must take back only my own last change, never someone else's, and must not overwrite an edit someone made after mine.
expected_behavior: Turns on the ledger with { ledger: true } in registerDocs' options; no undo stack, inverse ops or previous values kept by hand on the client or the server

The buttons send { action: "undo" } and { action: "redo" } over the socket (the WS client's send or call) with no cursor: over a socket the connection is the cursor, so each browser walks only its own writes
Treats a null answer as nothing to undo or redo
Treats an answer with conflict as the walk refused (nothing changed) and says so, rather than forcing the old values back with its own replace ops
Does not apply the undo's ops to the page itself: the change arrives through onOps or doc.data like any other write

query: With delta on SQLite: each venue has rooms, and each room has bookings. Opening venue:<n> should show the venue, its rooms and their bookings. A venue does not exist until someone first adds a room to it, and opening a new venue should show an empty one, not an error. Write the schema, the document, and client code that adds a room and then a booking in that room.
expected_behavior: defineSchema declares rooms with parent: "venues" and bookings with parent: "rooms", not hand-written foreign key columns
defineDoc("venue:", { root: "venues", include: ["rooms", "bookings"], implied: true }) with no scope (an implied document cannot declare one: defineDoc throws)
Does not insert or seed a venues row before the first write: the first add through the document makes it
Names venues by number (venue:1), not by text, so the app moves to Postgres unchanged
Adds the room with add /rooms/- and reads its id from what comes back (the echo's /rooms/<id> path or the row's id), never by guessing or by position
Adds the booking with add /bookings/- whose value carries rooms_id set to that room's id
Calls createTables(db, schema) before registerDocs
